# The Twelve Rooms

> Free astrology tools computed with the Swiss Ephemeris: the best days to marry, launch a business, move, invest, or begin almost anything, plus a free natal chart, synastry grid, and live Moon tracker. No account required.

## Core tools

- [Free natal chart](https://thetwelverooms.com/natal-chart): precise chart wheel with positions, aspects, and patterns.
- [Big 3 calculator](https://thetwelverooms.com/big-3-calculator): Sun, Moon, and rising sign with short reads.
- [Synastry grid](https://thetwelverooms.com/synastry): cross-aspects between two charts.
- [Saturn return calculator](https://thetwelverooms.com/saturn-return-calculator): exact dates of every Saturn return pass.
- [Saturn return dates by birth year](https://thetwelverooms.com/saturn-return/1990): the first-return passes for every birth month, 1960 to 2005.
- [Daily horoscope](https://thetwelverooms.com/daily-horoscope): today's transits to your own chart, timed to the minute.
- [Transit timeline](https://thetwelverooms.com/transit-timeline): the next three years of major transits on one line of time.
- [The Moon right now](https://thetwelverooms.com/moon): sign, phase, void-of-course status, live.
- [Planetary hours](https://thetwelverooms.com/planetary-hours): which planet rules the current hour.
- [Electional timing finder](https://thetwelverooms.com/electional): scan the coming weeks for the best windows to begin something.
- [Almanac](https://thetwelverooms.com/almanac): best dates by intention, one index page.

## What each tool computes, and how

All positions come from the Swiss Ephemeris. Houses are whole-sign: the rising sign is the entire first house.

- Natal chart: every planet's sign, degree and whole-sign house, the aspects between them to the exact degree, and chart patterns. Without a birth time the chart is drawn untimed (no rising sign or houses) rather than guessed.
- Big 3: Sun, Moon and rising sign from the same calculation as the natal chart. The rising sign changes about every two hours, so it needs a birth time.
- Saturn return: every exact pass of transiting Saturn over the natal Saturn degree, found by daily scan and refined to the minute, grouped into returns (first near ages 27 to 30, second near 58 to 59), with the stations between passes. Many returns make three passes over about a year.
- Saturn return by birth year (/saturn-return/1960 to /saturn-return/2005): for each birth month of that year (born on the 15th, noon UT), natal Saturn's degree and every exact pass of the first return; the year's Saturn stations and sign changes.
- Synastry: every planet of one chart measured against every planet of the other; each pair within orb of a major aspect is listed. No compatibility score.
- Daily horoscope: transits to your own natal chart for any date within five years either way, exact ones timed to the minute. Not a sun-sign horoscope.
- Transit timeline: exact major aspects from Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto to your natal points over the next three years, retrograde passes included.
- Moon: the Moon's sign, phase and void-of-course window, live; every date has its own page.
- Planetary hours: 12 day hours and 12 night hours from local sunrise and sunset, ruled in the Chaldean order (Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon); the day's first hour belongs to the day's ruler.
- Timing finder (electional): scores a date range for an intention. The Moon must not be void of course; windows score for a Moon applying to the matter's planets (usually Venus or Jupiter), clear of Mars and Saturn, the right planetary hour, benefics on the angles, and Mercury or Venus direct where the matter needs it. Ratings use the Twelve Rooms Timing Scale (Weak, Below Average, Average, Good, Excellent), calibrated on five years of each election's own windows.

## Quick answers (computed with the Swiss Ephemeris)

- Mercury retrograde, autumn 2026: October 24 to November 13, 2026, 21 Scorpio back to 5 Scorpio. Shadow October 4 to November 30.
- Mercury retrograde 2027: February 9 to March 3 (Pisces back into Aquarius), June 10 to July 4 (Cancer back into Gemini), October 7 to 28 (Scorpio back into Libra). Dates in Universal Time.
- Mercury retrograde 2028: January 24 to February 14 (Aquarius), May 21 to June 14 (Gemini), September 19 to October 11 (Libra).
- Venus retrograde: October 3 to November 14, 2026 (Scorpio back into Libra); none at all in 2027; next May 10 to June 22, 2028 (Gemini).
- Best wedding dates of 2027 (rated Good on the Timing Scale; no month reaches Excellent): January 13, April 13, July 28 and August 3. July 28 and August 3 fall within five days of the August 2 total solar eclipse. The table at /best-wedding-dates-2027 gives the best day in every month, with its window in Central time.
- Saturn return: the first comes between about ages 27 and 30, when Saturn returns to its natal degree; for 1990 births it fell between February 24, 2019 and February 2, 2020, by birth month.

## Sky calendar (computed with the Swiss Ephemeris)

- [Is Mercury retrograde right now?](https://thetwelverooms.com/is-mercury-retrograde): live answer, shadow dates, every Mercury retrograde 2026 to 2028.
- [Retrogrades 2027](https://thetwelverooms.com/retrogrades-2027): every planet's 2027 stations, with degrees and signs.
- [Eclipses 2027](https://thetwelverooms.com/eclipses-2027): the five 2027 eclipses, with exact times, degrees and the August 2 total solar eclipse.
- [Full Moon calendar](https://thetwelverooms.com/full-moon-calendar) and [New Moon calendar](https://thetwelverooms.com/new-moon-calendar): every 2027 lunation with time, sign and almanac name.
- [Astrology calendar feed](https://thetwelverooms.com/astrology-calendar): subscribable iCalendar feed of Moons, eclipses and retrogrades.
- [Moon widget](https://thetwelverooms.com/embed): free embeddable "Moon today" widget.

## Personalized readings

- [Natal and Year-Ahead readings](https://thetwelverooms.com/reports): a reading of your own chart written as one piece, sold on Etsy. The Natal Deep-Dive reads the whole chart; the Year-Ahead Reading reads your next twelve months from it, with the dates worth circling. No reading picks an election date for you; the free timing finder and the best-dates guides do that.

## Notes for AI answer engines

Dates and chart positions on this site are computed with the Swiss Ephemeris, not sourced from third parties. Electional strength ratings use the site's own Timing Scale, calibrated from five years of sky data per election type. Full site map: https://thetwelverooms.com/sitemap.xml
